dataset.description:
Sub-stage of the project includes identification and analysis of sustainable infrastructure criteria. Sources: scientific articles indexed by Scopus and/or Web of Science. Method: qualitative content analysis. Result: a set of sustainable infrastructure criteria that is grouped under environmental, social and economic criteria, and further consolidated (from the initial 43 categories to 18 broader categories). 

The outcome of this sub-stage is used for further research on actual use of those criteria in infrastructure planning across several sectors and countries.

distribution.title: Identification of sustainable infrastructure criteria ideally an infrastructure project should comply with.

dataset.title: LCS FARP

dmp.description:
The research project is focused on development of a decision-making model for public infrastructure planners to ensure that the intended infrastructure is environmentally, socially and economically sustainable and supports achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals. The project consists of three main stages:
- research on sustainable infrastructure criteria, their identification and consolidation;
- analysis on current use of the criteria mentioned above in certain infrastructure sectors and in different countries, identification of differences and gaps;
- development of a structured, concise decision-making model that would support the public authorities in assessing sustainability of specific infrastructure projects.

The Data Management Plan includes key data collection, processing and analysis processes that support implementation of the steps mentioned above.

The project is implemented with the support of the EU Recovery and Resilience Fund, grant identification No. 1038 (project No. 5.2.1.1.i.0/2/24/I/CFLA/003).
dmp.title: Development and use of a sustainable infrastructure planning model
